Description: Registers an NF, SCP or SEPP Instance profile in the NRF (includes general NF parameters and services).
Complete replacement of the NF Profile of a given NF Instance in the NRF.
Deregisters an NF Instance from the NRF (removes the NF profile and its services).
Creates a subscription so an NF Service Consumer can be notified of registration/deregistration/profile changes of NF (or SCP/SEPP) Instances according to filter criteria.
NRF notifies subscribed NF or SCP Instances of changes (registration, deregistration, profile change) by sending the notification to the subscriber's callback URI.
Removes an existing subscription to notifications.
Retrieves a list of NF Instances currently registered in the NRF (optionally filtered / paginated).
Retrieves the NF profile of a given NF Instance registered in the NRF.
